title: Lightweight structural truss optimization
summary: Least-mass discrete sizing and topology for the classic 10-bar and 25-bar trusses under frozen linear models, every design re-solved by two separately coded solvers; published reference and tube/Euler extension profiles kept separate.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt (@Mister-Meeseeks) coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. Review capacity is surge: no fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. Results are author-checked: both solvers were written in one session. Independent review of the frozen models, benchmark transcription and both solvers (ideally against an external solver), and of each new candidate's two-solver check, is wanted before acceptance. See PARTICIPATION.md.

credit.policy: Record consenting contributors and reviewers in CONTRIBUTORS.md and result packages; cite benchmark authors; disclose AI assistance; no automatic paper authorship.

requirements.note: Python >=3.12 with the pinned NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib stack (requirements-lock.txt) in a local virtual environment; CPU only, no GPU. Environment creation needs a package download. Tested on macOS arm64/Python 3.14.
